name: ESOP / Exercise to Date Sync
description: 读取 Futu 员工行权记录源工作簿的行权汇总数据，并替换 Exercise Record 展示数据。

tasks.name: Extract Futu Exercise Summary

params.emptyColumns: 姓名, 工号, 牛牛号, 用户ID, 授予编号, 授予日期, 授予价(USD), 行权日期, 行权下单数量, 行权成功数量, 行权成本(USD), 扣除/卖出数量, 成交数量

tasks.description: 从 Futu 员工行权记录源工作簿提取行权汇总数据（行权汇总数据 Sheet）。 该输入为可选：未提供时输出空 dataframe，月度运行不会因此中断（记录页该月显示为空）。 未提供文件时按 emptyColumns 输出空表，供下游合并使用。

tasks.name: Project Futu Exercise Summary

params.sql:
select
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], '') as string)), '') as [Name],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], '') as string)), '') as [Employee No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([牛牛号], '') as string)), '') as [Futubull ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([用户ID], '') as string)), '') as [User ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予编号], '') as string)), '') as [Grant No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予日期], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Date],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予价(USD)], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Price(USD)],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([行权日期], '') as string)), '') as [Exercise Date],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权下单数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([行权下单数量] as number) end as [Ordered Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成功数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([行权成功数量] as number) end as [Exercised Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成本(USD)], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([行权成本(USD)] as number) end as [Exercise Cost(USD)],
  case when cast(coalesce([扣除/卖出数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([扣除/卖出数量] as number) end as [Deduction/Selling Qty.],
  case when cast(coalesce([成交数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([成交数量] as number) end as [Dealt Qty.]
from {exercises}
where trim(concat('', coalesce([工号], ''))) <> ''
  and trim(cast(coalesce([工号], '') as string)) <> '工号'

tasks.description: 将 Futu 行权汇总数据的中文字段映射为 Exercise Record 的 13 列标准契约，并过滤空工号行。

tasks.name: Extract exercise_futu base
tasks.description: 读取上一月的累计快照作为 base；未提供时输出空表，合并结果即当月增量。

params.emptyColumns: Name, Employee No., Futubull ID, User ID, Grant No., Grant Date, Grant Price(USD), Exercise Date, Ordered Qty, Exercised Qty, Exercise Cost(USD), Deduction/Selling Qty., Dealt Qty.

tasks.name: Merge exercise_futu records
tasks.description: 按 Employee No. + Grant No. + Exercise Date 幂等合并 base 与本月增量：同键以增量覆盖，base 独有的行保留（历史不丢）。

tasks.name: Persist Futu BCI Exercises to Date File
tasks.description: 将标准化后的 Futu 行权汇总数据输出为 Excel 文件，展示层读取最新成功执行的输出文件。 输出文件名带月份后缀，便于在 Files 中辨认当月快照。 输入为空时不落盘，避免覆盖上一次有效快照。 输入为 base 与本月的幂等合并结果，即截至当月的累计快照。
